title: 5 Stars for Hugo
text: Hugo was an excellent tour guide - wonderful knowledge of the city. And the churros and chocolate were delicious - highly recommend hiring him!
author: nolateacher

title: Walking through old Barcelona
text: Hugo was wonderful! Very knowledgeable and friendly
author: M553VSjoshuak

title: Highly recommended!
text: We had a truly wonderful, entertaining tour with Ariana, who brought history and sights to life for us in a very entertaining way. The churros were very delicious. We had a great morning with her.
author: Vroni2015

title: Super!
text:
Adriana was simply super, lively, cheerful and told us a lot about Catalonia. A big compliment to our tour guide, many thanks and regards, C. Ueberholz 
The churros were excellent.
author: connyu916

title: Came for the churros, stayed for the history
text: Ariana was great and very engaging! She held my 9 yo and 11yo attentions so well they were quoting facts she gave us the rest of the day. We loved this tour and it was an amazing way to see some of the city and have a great snack!
author: amandarL7995WT

title: Amazing churrous
text: Ariana was an amzing guide, fantastic with the kids, delivering a tailored highly communicative amd entertaining oral history on the nuances of Barcelona history in the Gothic quarter. Changed my opinion on churrous for the much better
author: 784gordonw

title: Family fun for all
text: Ariana was wonderful. Her interesting anecdotes added so much value to the experience. She pointed out unique elements as we walked around. Everyone is our family..adults, teens and younger children enjoyed the experience.
author: Deahne_T
